text.tspan: For anyone juggling more than they admit.
A park cleanup turned into introductions I had
needed for years.
The group chat works better when it has a
weekly digest.
Patience is a community organizing skill.
— Adriana
Writing it down so I do not forget.
Community is a practice of returning.
We mapped who already does the work before
inventing a new group.
Listen across difference without abandoning
your values.
A city staffer explained the process without
jargon for once.
Credit the quiet people who keep things
running.
We collected signatures the old-fashioned way:
walking and talking.
Show up before you have a hot take.
The library event had more kids than chairs.
Good problem.
Hospitality makes meetings survivable.
I volunteered for the unglamorous treasurer
role. Somebody had to.
Local power is often procedural. Learn the
procedures.

Patience is a community organizing skill.
A disagreement stayed about the proposal, not
about people's character.
Belonging is built in repeated ordinary
appearances.
I brought cookies to the meeting and people
stayed for the hard item.
Small infrastructure wins change daily life.

participate.
